title: Dinner Lady Tobacco Caramel 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Bar Salts Caramel Tobacco offers a rich and indulgent take on classic Tobacco. The smooth, earthy notes of Tobacco are perfectly complemented by layers of sweet Caramel, warm Vanilla, and a touch of Honey, creating a deeply satisfying and well-rounded vape with a velvety finish. Part of the Bar Salts collection, Caramel Tobacco is designed to replicate the full-bodied, layered flavours often found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures a long-lasting depth of flavour while maintaining a smooth and enjoyable vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid provides an excellent balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation delivers a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their dedication to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a trusted choice for vapers.
